description.value: A municipal campground on Okanagan Lake's shore in Summerland with showers, potable water, and flush washrooms — a solid amenity-rich stop on the Okanagan cycling corridor, busiest in peak summer.

address.value: 6321 Peach Orchard Rd, Summerland, BC V0H 1Z1, Canada
